Trump Unveils Voluntary AI Safety Agreement

President Trump brought executives from several major AI companies to the White House and introduced a voluntary pact focused on independent audits, stronger internal controls and board-level oversight of advanced AI systems. Trump released the White House Accord on Super Intelligence in a Truth Social post. The agreement was also described as a "Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities."
